P_0x002936.en: A member of the Shtedonias military's special operations unit. The type who can fully commit to evil if the mission demands it. He firmly believes soldiers must be absolutely obedient to orders.

P_0x002A15.en: A Kirkus military officer. He harbors feelings for Ratel that go beyond respect for a superior.

P_0x002A93.en: A Kirkus military officer. Blunt and outspoken by nature, which may be why his promotions lag behind his actual ability.

P_0x002B23.en: A Shtedonias soldier. Highly skilled as a pilot, but prone to clashing with superiors, which keeps him from being promoted.

P_0x002C58.en: A soldier of the Kirkus army. A magic officer skilled in sorcery. Fastidious and obsessed with justice.

P_0x002CE3.en: A demon priest serving the god of destruction, Sarva Volkruss. Polite in speech but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prepare for Volkruss's revival.

P_0x002DAF.en: Captain of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron. Quiet and seemingly calm, but only because he hides his feelings - in truth a hot-blooded man who burns quietly inside. Loves gambling, and gets more excited the worse the odds are. He and Excellen are lovers, and though he rarely shows it, he privately treasures her above all else. Rank: Lieutenant.

P_0x002F68.en: A pilot of the ATX Team's Steel Dragon Squadron. Calm and intelligent at heart, but so self-promoting and prone to going with the flow that others rarely see that side of her. She resents how coldly Kyosuke always treats her, but she loves him more than anyone. An excellent pilot, especially skilled at high-mobility and gunnery combat. A heavy drinker who loves watching others get drunk. Rank: Ensign.
